mapper.select: SELECT C.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID, C.BRANCH AS BRANCH, C.MDATE AS MDATE, F.INVESTMENT_CYCLE AS INVESTMENT_CYCLE FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.P_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.IS_CYCLE = #{isCycle} AND D.ISSUE_STATUS = #{issueStatus} INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD F ON B.FINPROD_ID = F.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION E ON E.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND E.BRANCH = C.BRANCH AND E.PORTFOLIO_ID = D.PORTFOLIO_ID AND E.CDATE = C.MDATE AND E.HODING_TYPE = #{hodingType} INNER JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM G ON G.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND A.PROFIT_TYPE = #{profitType} AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND A.IS_SUS = #{isSus} AND G.CONTINUE_FLAG = #{continueFlag} AND C.MDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') - 1
